documents.title: X2D Spec Sheet
documents.note: Linked from the store page Specs block "Download PDF" button (featureConfig.downloadButton.downloadUrl), which the package parse does not read, so the deterministic layer has no document row for it.

notes: Store page read from the P0 corpus (us.store.bambulab.com/products/x2d, 2026-10-16T06:55:40Z) and parsed with the package (extractPage + buildImportPayload with the manifest row): the parse yields one us_110v electrical.voltage row (feature bullet "Voltage Range: 100 – 120 V"), not_found rows for the expected printer keys and one variant note. Its page-builder Specs block keeps the full technical table in featureConfig.richText (RSC row $1b2) and the In-the-box table in featureConfig.richText ($1b1); the package read list drops richText, so neither is parsed. Every curated value was compared with that raw table; differences carry a conflict note.

Store page values used here (source_kind store_page) are only rows the spec sheet does not carry: high-flow max flow, recommended space, US gross weights, and three unverified prose facts (noise, multi-colour, certifications). The store page is not listed in searched because searched URLs become customer-visible checked_sources and a store_page ref is owner-only.

printing.supported_filament is not written and not listed as not_published: the sheet publishes per-hotend lists (printing.filament_main_hotend, printing.filament_aux_hotend, printing.filament_aux_hotend_caution) instead of one list. extrusion.extruder_gear / extrusion.extruder_motor are covered by the main_ and aux_ keys.

Option values (manifest value_labels and sku_codes are empty): X2D 720069852747550722, X2D AMS Combo 720069852747550723, X2D Print More Bundle (2 AMS 2 Pro included) 753859494895067136, X2D Combo Print with Care Bundle 776210262356197377.
